description: Agent Inventory: submit receiving records with the purchase or consignment orders they answer to: each order with its id, order number, kind (purchase or consignment), supplier, the day the shipment left and each ordered line with the item and units; each receiving record with its id, receiving record number, the order number it answers to, the day received, whether it is recorded as full or partial, and each received line with the item, the units received and any note on a difference. The signed report gives the orders and the receipts, each received line against the units still due on its order line, each item received against the lines its order names, each receipt recorded as full against what the order still holds after it, and each receiving date against the day the shipment left, and counts them, and names divergent receiving records: a quantity received that differs from the quantity ordered with no note, an item received that was never ordered, a partial receipt recorded as full, and a receipt dated before the shipment it answers to; then a receipt citing no order and a receiving record number recorded twice, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No orders, no receiving records, an order number the orders do not hold, no full or partial status, or no shipment dates leaves those points unverified. Orders and receipts match by their numbers read as letters and digits, items by their SKU or their words with plurals folded, receipts read in the order received so a later receipt reads against what earlier ones left due, a noted difference reads as explained, units compare to the hundredth and dates by the day. This reads goods received against what was ordered, before the counts and the valuation rely on them. Verdict inventory_receiving_divergent, inventory_receiving_partial, inventory_receiving_unverified or inventory_receiving_consistent. POST /api/inventory-receiving-check. Reads the inventory records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never moves stock, never places or cancels an order, never writes to anyone’s inventory system and never adjusts a record, which stay with the business and its staff, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Inventory reads inventory records: a stock count, receiving records, shrinkage and loss records, a stock adjustment log, an inventory valuation, reorder records, a dead stock record and consignment stock records, each against the system stock record, the purchase or consignment orders, the count and sales records, the count and the period close, the counts and purchase records, the stock levels and lead times, the movement window and period report, or the sale and settlement records it answers to. The family checks whether the stock record can be trusted; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the ledger the stock feeds, and the boutique tools act on one store’s orders. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-inventory-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-inventory/.
